decisions.reason: As the flagship transactional email service closely aligned with the firm's cloud messaging direction and prominently featured on the homepage, it strongly leverages existing messaging expertise and strategic focus, making a drop very unlikely.
Document capture builds on established document workflow knowledge and shows a concrete customer result, indicating the firm can assimilate and apply related knowledge, so it is likely retained.
Email-fax conversion is related to existing multichannel document workflows but has only a minor web presence; absorptive capacity is high but weaker early signals warrant moderate drop risk.

Fax delivery optimization is very close to the firm's core messaging infrastructure and benefits from deep existing technical knowledge, though its feature-like nature raises some risk of being folded into the base offer.
Email sandbox threat protection extends the firm's secure messaging capabilities and existing email expertise, but its limited promotional presence adds only modest drop risk.
